FACILITY   (SYNCY,2ZZZCER) CERN nTOF facility.                    2336900100055 
            Protons (7E+12 protons/pulse) were accelerated to     2336900100056 
             20 GeV.                                              2336900100057 
INC-SOURCE (SPALL) 1.2E+5 neutrons/pulse were produced in a       2336900100058 
            cylindrical Pb spallation target (1.3 t in mass,      2336900100059 
            40 cm in length, 60 cm in diameter).                  2336900100060 
           Neutrons were moderated by Pb target itself, 1 cm      2336900100061 
            layer of demineralized water and 4 cm layer of        2336900100062 
            borated water (H2O + 1.28% H3BO3 mass fraction).      2336900100063 
           The neutron beam at sample position can be             2336900100064 
            approximated by Gaussian shape with sigma=0.62 cm.    2336900100065 
           Flux was measured at the same time by SiMoN [6Li(n,t)  2336900100066 
            reaction] and MGAS [10B(n,a) and 235U(n,f) reactions] 2336900100067 
            detectors.                                            2336900100068 
           Flux was also measured by PTB and PPAC [235U(n,f)      2336900100069 
            reaction] detectors in the same year, but not at the  2336900100070 
            same time.                                            2336900100071 
SAMPLE     36.5-mg 241AmO2 infiltrated into a 305-mg Al2O3        2336900100072 
            matrix. The 241Am mass (32.23+/-0.19 mg) was          2336900100073 
            determined by calorimetry at JRC Karlsruhe.           2336900100074 
           237Np (~0.9 mg) and 240Pu (~0.016 mg) were detected    2336900100075 
            as impurities during resonance analysis.              2336900100076 
DETECTOR   (BAF2) Total Absorption Calorimeter (TAC) made of 40   2336900100077 
            BaF2 crystals (15 cm in length covering ~95% of the   2336900100078 
            solid angle) to detect in coincidence (nearly) all    2336900100079 
            the gamma rays coming from capture reactions.         2336900100080 
           (SI) Silicon flux monitor (SiMon) consisted of thin    2336900100081 
            6Li deposit on thin Mylar foil surrounded by a set of 2336900100082 
            four silicon detectors outside the neutron beam for   2336900100083 
            recording the tritons and alpha particles from the    2336900100084 
            6Li(n,a)3H reaction.                                  2336900100085 
METHOD     Total energy absorption.                               2336900100086 
           (TOF) Flight path length of 185.59+/-0.02 m.           2336900100087 
MONITOR    (79-AU-197(N,G)79-AU-198,,SIG)                         2336900100088 
            Absolute normalization to the saturated 4.9 eV        2336900100089 
            capture resonance of 197Au.                           2336900100090
